syncMode.description: incremental resumes from latest ledger. resync_from_start deletes prior data then re-fetches — destructive, so it must be asked for explicitly and is no longer this endpoint's default. resync is accepted for backward compatibility and normalized to incremental.

startTime.description: Unix ms — replaces the per-function incremental cursor rather than flooring it, so it can reach back behind data already stored. This is the non-destructive way to backfill a gap; resync_from_start wipes first.

functions.description: Narrow to specific provider functions (must be non-empty if provided).

triggerSource.description: What initiated the resync (used for auditing/telemetry).
